title: rtl-design result.json contract
description: Complete contract for asic/<module>/Design/rtl-design/result.json. stage_specific has no pass-required fields; on status=fail it requires fail_reason (if/then below), the one-line failure narrative, and may name fix_owner. The stage's substance is handed off through its promoted sidecars and its per-child intent reviews, not through this envelope, and TOP is not restated here: it is manifest.module, which every consumer declares as an input.

fix_owner.description: On status=fail: the rule that must act, named by this stage from what it read in the raw tool output. Deliberately NOT an enum — the derived input closure in rules.py is the only authority on which names are legal, and decide checks it there. Naming this stage itself (its in-stage remedy is exhausted) or naming nobody both mean a human decides.
